messages:
alice_support: customer reported duplicate charges after token rotation + retry storm. they rotated API token, client started getting 429s and kept retrying, ended up with duplicate POSTs to our billing endpoint. attaching repro and a snippet of their logs.

alice_support: REPRO STEPS pasted by customer:
```
1) create session using old token
2) rotate token via admin console
3) client gets 401 on next request, refresh logic retries POST /v1/charges
4) first retry returns 429, client applies default retry loop (3 attempts) and ends up sending payload multiple times
5) billing cron processed duplicate charges
```

ben_engineer: thanks. do we have their request headers (Idempotency-Key?) and SDK version? most dupes happen when no idempotency and client retries blindly.

alice_support: i grabbed the debug dump they sent. headers show no Idempotency-Key, sdk: official-js v1.2.1. snippet: 
```
RequestID: r-9ab1c2
POST /v1/charges 200ms
-> 401 (token rotated)
-> retry 1: 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 Retry-After:2
-> retry 2: 429 Retry-After:3
-> retry 3: 200 (charge accepted)
```

carmen_sre: yep. two things: 1) SDK default retry policy should not retry non-idempotent POSTs without an Idempotency-Key. 2) when rate-limit headers are present, clients should respect Retry-After and apply exponential backoff + jitter to avoid thundering.

ben_engineer: agreed. immediate remediation steps for customer: ask them to 1) stop the client or pause billing worker, 2) we can dedupe recent charges based on payload/signature, 3) recommend adding Idempotency-Key header (UUID per logical operation). example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/charges \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \\
  -d '{"amount":1000, "user_id": 42}'
```
python example for SDK config: 
```
# quick mitigation: enable safe retry behavior
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., retries=2, backoff_strategy="expo_jitter", require_idempotency_for_post=True)
```

alice_support: forwarded those instructions to customer. they asked whether SDKs will change defaults so other customers don't hit this.

ben_engineer: proposal: change official SDKs so that for POST endpoints we set retries=0 by default unless Idempotency-Key is provided or user opt-in to safe retries. Also default backoff to expo+jitter and honour Retry-After header. I'll open an RFC.

carmen_sre: also add to Console alerts: when a token rotation happens we should surface a warning if many 401->429 sequences are detected and suggest pausing clients. could reduce support load.

deploy-bot: ticket #SUP-4876 created: "Investigate SDK default retry behavior for non-idempotent endpoints" assigned to ben_engineer.

ben_engineer: i'll PR a patch to js and python SDKs: - do not retry POST by default unless Idempotency-Key present - respect Retry-After - add warning in changelog. ETA: 2 days to PR, 1 week for release.

alice_support: thanks all — customer accepted temporary refund + idempotency guidance. marking this thread resolved on our side, will follow up after SDK release. :thumbsup:
